title: Partners and sponsors
text: The Bodensee Symposium is made possible by the three organising ICOM committees and by partners who support museum work across borders.
emptyText: Our partners and sponsors will be listed here.
becomeText: Would you like to support the symposium as a partner or sponsor? It brings museum directors and professionals from Germany, Austria, Switzerland, France, Italy and beyond to Bern, in the same week as the EMYA2027 conference. We are happy to discuss options with you.
